 Fort Bend County District Court
 Cause No. 2025-CV-0025
 Ryan Roberts, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
5-19-25
Counsel for defendant:
Stephanie Williams, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant generally denies each and every allegation contained in Plaintiff's Original Petition and demands strict
proof thereof by a preponderance of the evidence, as required by the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure.
Subject to and without waiving the foregoing general denial, Defendant asserts the following affirmative defenses.
First, Plaintiff's alleged injuries and damages were proximately caused, in whole or in part, by Plaintiff's own
negligence, including failure to keep a proper lookout, failure to control speed, and failure to maintain a safe distance
from the vehicle ahead. Under Chapter 33 of the Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code, any recovery must be
reduced by Plaintiff's percentage of responsibility, and Plaintiff may be barred from recovery if that percentage
exceeds fifty percent.
Second, Defnedant invokes the proportionate responsibility provisions of Chapter 33, requesting that the trier of fact
determine the percentage of responsibility of each claimant, defendant, settling person, and responsible third party,
and that any judgment be limited accordingly.
Third, Defendant asserts that Plaintiff failed to mitigate damages by failing to follow reasonable medical advice and
treatment, and that any recovery for medical expenses must be limited to amounts actually paid or incurred by or on
behalf of Plaintiff, as provided in Section 41.0105 of the Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code.
</page>

  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
